about.title: Applied AI & Systems Engineer.
about.intro: Applied AI & Systems Engineer working at the intersection of Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, and Systems Development. Background in Deep Learning and Computer Vision — object detection, instance segmentation, pattern recognition — now expanding into LLM applications, RAG systems, developer tooling, and Linux desktop systems.
about.detailed: My work spans four fronts: systems & software engineering (wiring AI models to APIs, databases, and UIs; back-end services, data pipelines, dev tools, Linux/desktop automation, cross-platform apps), AI & machine learning (computer vision, LLM apps, RAG, training and evaluation workflows — applied to agriculture, medical imaging, and beyond), research & engineering (translating ideas into reproducible software: datasets, experimentation pipelines, Scopus-indexed papers including Q1 journals), and teaching & mentorship (Bangkit Academy 2024 ML mentor for 25+ students; lab assistant at Mulawarman University for ML, DL, DSA, and OOP).
about.research: B.CS. (S.Kom.) from Universitas Mulawarman. Beyond engineering I co-author applied-AI research: multiple Scopus-indexed papers, including Q1 journals in Smart Agricultural Technology and Artificial Intelligence in Agriculture.
about.hobbies: Tinkering with software and hardware — small tools for my own productivity. Gaming across Steam, Epic, GOG and Xbox; occasionally developing games (Unity, Godot, Ren'Py).
